verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Advance's Scribe Agent explicitly transcribes incident calls in real time and feeds those transcripts plus Slack data into Post-Incident Reviews to auto-build chronological narratives, and AI-generated PIRs are now GA, directly matching 'live summaries, drafted updates, scribed call notes.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of transcription accuracy and update-drafting quality beyond first-party docs.
